_note: woo-review-triage (rows 19.7 to 19.11). Relevance apart from the disclosure verdict, visible triage rules, and batches assigned to named reviewers. No x-openregister-hierarchy: OpenRegister refuses a parent that references another schema. The private authorization block of REQ-WRT-006 comes with section 6, once woo-request-scoped-access sets the grants; declaring it before then would lock the reviewers out.

documentReview.title: Document review
documentReview.description: Per document collected on a case: is it about the request at all, who or which rule said so, its batch, and the pages a reviewer saw.

case.title: Case
case.description: The case the document was collected on.

relevance.title: Relevance
relevance.description: Whether the document is about the request: not marked yet, in scope or out of scope.

relevanceSource.title: Marked by
relevanceSource.description: Whether a reviewer or a triage rule set the relevance.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: The triage rule that decided the relevance, when a rule did.

overturnedRule.title: Overturned rule
overturnedRule.description: The triage rule whose marking a reviewer changed.

batch.title: Batch
batch.description: The review batch the document is in.

depth.title: Review depth
depth.description: The review depth that applied: every page, or a sample and its size and seed.

pageCount.title: Page count
pageCount.description: How many pages the document has.

pagesRequired.title: Pages required
pagesRequired.description: The page numbers a reviewer must see before a verdict.

pagesSeen.title: Pages seen
pagesSeen.description: The pages a reviewer saw, with who and when.

triageRule.title: Triage rule
triageRule.description: A visible rule on a case that marks collected documents in or out of scope without a reviewer opening each one.

case.title: Case
case.description: The case the rule belongs to.

name.title: Name
name.description: The rule's name, shown on the case and on every document it marked.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: All of these must hold: custodian, source system, mime type, date range, sender domain, text that is or is not in the document.

effect.title: Effect
effect.description: What a match marks the document as.

order.title: Order
order.description: Rules run in this order; the first match decides.

active.title: Active
active.description: Whether the rule runs when the rules are applied.

reviewBatch.title: Review batch
reviewBatch.description: A named part of a case's in-scope documents, assigned to one reviewer through a task.

case.title: Case
case.description: The case the batch belongs to.

name.title: Name
name.description: The batch's name, shown on the case and on the reviewer's task.

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: The filter the documents were taken by: custodian, source system or rule.

assignee.title: Reviewer
assignee.description: The Nextcloud user who reviews the batch.

task.title: Task
task.description: The dossiq task that assigns the batch.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether the batch is still open.

documentReview.title: Document review
documentReview.description: Whether cases of this type review their documents for relevance before a verdict, and how deep. A case type that leaves it out has no document review.

enabled.title: Document review
enabled.description: Cases of this type mark each document in or out of scope, in batches for named reviewers, before a verdict.

reviewDepth.title: Review depth
reviewDepth.description: Per document type: every page, or a sample of a number of pages. A type it does not name is every page.
